children: reported a record $28.02 billion backlog and a quarterly-record segment margin, and shares surged 11.08% to $80.53 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 17. The infrastructure design and consulting firm moved sharply against a falling market, per StockTitan's session recap.

Fiscal fourth-quarter revenue fell 7% to $3.88 billion, but net service revenue rose 3% on an adjusted basis to $1.92 billion and the segment adjusted operating margin climbed 110 basis points to 18.2%. Adjusted EPS jumped 20% to $1.63, and backlog grew 13%. For fiscal 2027, AECOM guides to organic net service revenue growth of 4% to 6%, adjusted EPS of $6.15 to $6.35, a 17.6% segment margin and free cash flow of about $300 million after roughly $500 million of cash use on two construction management projects. The dividend rises 10% to $0.34.

The EPS midpoint puts the shares at about 12.9 times next year's adjusted earnings, while backlog equals roughly 1.8 years of revenue at the latest quarterly run rate. GuruFocus gives AECOM a GF Score of 67/100, a middling profile with fair profitability and weak momentum before this rally. Its GF Value of $88.01 puts the close about 8.5% below the model, so GuruFocus sees the shares as fairly valued even after the jump. The next test is cash conversion, since the $500 million drag from two projects keeps free cash flow well below earnings this year.

title: AECOM Stocks Surge 11.08% as Record $28 Billion Backlog Backs 2027 Guide
